name: How long does it take to install privacy glass for an average home?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install privacy glass for an average home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for privacy glass depends on the number and size of windows, the type of privacy solution chosen, and the complexity of the installation. For a typical residential project involving a few standard-sized windows with frosted or tinted glass, installation might take one to two days. Projects involving specialized smart glass or a larger number of windows could extend to several days. We will provide a precise timeline estimate during your initial consultation after assessing your home's specific requirements.
